Stopgap for deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness Discussion #8550.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-sandbox-temp-guard [English](#english) · 中文 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Windows 沙箱自愈插件：当系统临时目录清理把会话私有 temp 目录 （`%TEMP%\dsh-XXXXXX`）删掉时，自动重建目录并补回 ACL 授权，让命令不再报 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`；同时对仍然漏网的"后端不可用"错误追加排查指引，避免 Agent 把它误判成"沙箱已损坏"而反复申请 `danger-full-access` 提权。 对应上游讨论：[deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness Discussion #8550](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8550) ## 它解决什么 在 Windows 上，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` 为每个 (会话, 工作区) 组合创建一次 私有临时目录并缓存整个 provider 生命周期： ```js const tempDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'dsh-')) // %TEMP%\dsh-XXXXXX // + 一个可撤销的 capability-SID ACL 授权 this.tempCapabilities.set(key, { dir: tempDir, writeSid, grant }) ``` 之后每次 `confine()` 都直接复用缓存的 `dir`，**不检查目录是否还存在**。一旦 Storage Sense / 清理工具 / 手动删除把这个目录清掉： 1. runner 收到 `--temp <已消失的路径>`，`requireDirectory` 失败 → `windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory`（exit 127） 2. seam 按 fail-closed 原则抛出 `SandboxUnavailableError`（`SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`） 3. **该会话内此后每条命令都失败，且重试无效**（失败发生在命令执行之前）， 直到 DSH 重启。缓存里的坏路径会一直用下去。 同一个环境里多个会话会相继中招（实测 `dsh-X5ECMI`、`dsh-uTBiqr`、`dsh-r0YqAq`）。 ## 插件做什么 1. **修复（核心）**：在每次工具执行前（并可配置地周期性）找到活跃 sandbox provider 缓存的 temp capability，对缺失的目录执行 `mkdirSync` 并重新 `grant.add(dir)` （目录没了，挂在它上面的 ACE 也随之消失，必须补授）。命令随即恢复正常， 错误根本不会浮到模型面前。 2. **注解（卫生）**：如果 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` / `windows-acl-run: --temp` 仍然出现 在工具结果里，`tools/post-execute` 会给结果追加一段指引，明确告诉模型： *这是后端基础设施故障，不是策略拒绝；不要用 sandbox_permissions 提权；守卫已重建 temp 目录，请原样重试一次；仍失败则需要重开会话。* ## 安装 任选其一（版本以 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 实测，安装机制来自官方 `dsh plugin`）： ```sh # GitHub 源（未发布 npm 时的默认路径；DSH-Plugins-Marketplace 等市场的 # topic:dsh-plugin 收录插件，一键安装走的也是这个 spec） npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wsm000/dsh-sandbox-temp-guard # npm（若本插件已发布到 npm；市场对已发布 npm 的插件会优先走 npm，更快更稳） npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sandbox-temp-guard # 本地 tarball（开发/内测） pnpm pack # 得到 dsh-sandbox-temp-guard-0.1.0.tgz npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-sandbox-temp-guard # 版本变化时先移除 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-sandbox-temp-guard-0.1.0.tgz ``` 本插件零运行时依赖，`file:///` 源码 overlay 亦可加载： ```yaml # dev.patch.yml - insert: - id: sandbox-temp-guard name: 'file:///C:/abs/path/to/dsh-sandbox-temp-guard/src/index.js' config: repairBeforeToolExecution: true sweepIntervalMs: 60000 annotateBackendFailure: true ``` ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile dev --patch ./dev.patch.yml ``` ## 配置（cordis.patch.yml） | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `repairBeforeToolExecution` | `true` | 每次工具执行前扫一遍并修复 | | `sweepIntervalMs` | `60000` | 周期兜底扫描间隔，`0` 关闭 | | `annotateBackendFailure` | `true` | 对后端失败结果追加排查指引 | ## 验证 ```sh node test/run-test.mjs # 17 项离线断言：发现/重建/补授/容错/钩子接线/注解 ``` ## 设计约束与已知限制 - **零运行时依赖**（仅 node 内置模块），因此 tarball / npm / `file://` overlay 三种安装方式都可用；`ctx.get('sandbox')` 为可选访问，缺失时安全降级。 - 对 provider 内部结构（`tempCapabilities`）的访问是**通用发现**（遍历对象图寻找 Map 形态、条目含 `{ dir, grant.add }` 的缓存），上游改名时退化为 no-op 而不是崩溃。 已在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 的 `dsh-sandbox-local` 上验证字段形状。 - 本插件是**上游修复落地前的过渡方案**；上游正确修法是在 `materializeAclGrant()` 复用缓存前检查目录存在、缺失则重建并补授。 - 只处理 temp 目录被清理这一种故障；provider 完全不可用（如 ACL 后端崩溃）时， 注解会提示重开会话，这是当前唯一恢复手段。 MIT License. --- # dsh-sandbox-temp-guard (English) A self-healing guard plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Windows ACL sandbox. **The bug** ([upstream Discussion #8550](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8550)): `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` caches one private temp directory per (session, workspace) — `%TEMP%\dsh-XXXXXX` plus a capability-SID ACL grant — for the provider's lifetime and reuses the cached path unconditionally. Once OS temp cleanup deletes that directory, every `confine()` passes a stale `--temp`, the `windows-acl-run` runner refuses to start (`--temp is not an existing directory`, exit 127), and the seam fails closed with `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` — **every command in that session then fails until DSH restarts**. **The plugin**: 1. *Repair* — before every tool execution (plus a periodic sweep), locate the live sandbox provider's cached temp capabilities, recreate missing directories, and re-apply their capability ACEs. The failure never reaches the model. 2. *Annotate* — if a `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` / `windows-acl-run: --temp` failure still lands in a tool result, append a remediation block: it is a **backend infrastructure failure, not a policy denial**; do **not** escalate with `sandbox_permissions`; retry once; restart the session if it persists. **Install** (DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2, verified on 0.1.7-rc.2): ```sh # GitHub source (default path while the plugin is not on npm; the topic:dsh-plugin # marketplaces one-click-install through the same spec) npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wsm000/dsh-sandbox-temp-guard # npm (once published; marketplaces prefer the npm package when it exists) npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sandbox-temp-guard # local tarball npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-sandbox-temp-guard-0.1.0.tgz ``` Source-overlay (`--patch`) install works too — the plugin has **zero runtime dependencies** (node builtins only). **Config** (`cordis.patch.yml`): `repairBeforeToolExecution` (true), `sweepIntervalMs` (60000), `annotateBackendFailure` (true). **Tests**: `node test/run-test.mjs` — 17 offline assertions covering discovery, recreation, ACE re-grant, failure containment, hook wiring, annotation, and missing-service degradation. This is a stopgap until the framework fix lands (recreate-on-reuse inside `materializeAclGrant`). MIT.

plugins.description: Novel-as-wallpaper reader for DSH Desktop
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-novel-wallpaper

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4C6EF5.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/kongbai-shike/dsh-novel-wallpaper?style=flat)](https://github.com/kongbai-shike/dsh-novel-wallpaper/stargazers)

> 把 TXT 小说变成 DSH 的「壁纸」。正文垫在整个界面**背后**，一个会隐身的小浮窗负责遥控。

等模型回话的几十秒，顺手看两页小说 —— 不用多开窗口，不用切标签页，也不占着对话区。
把鼠标挪开，界面就是原来的界面。

---

## 目录

- [它长什么样](#它长什么样)
- [安装](#安装)
- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [阅读控制：滚轮与方向键](#阅读控制滚轮与方向键)
- [老板键](#老板键)
- [设置](#设置)
- [分章规则](#分章规则)
- [隐私](#隐私)
- [兼容性](#兼容性)
- [设计取舍](#设计取舍)
- [开发](#开发)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [反馈与贡献](#反馈与贡献)
- [许可](#许可)

---

## 它长什么样

小说正文渲染成一个铺满窗口的文字层，压在 `document.body` 的 `z-index: -2` 上，
并且 `pointer-events: none` —— 它**从不接触鼠标**，点击永远落在真正的界面上。

上面盖一层可调浓度的压暗层（`z-index: -1`），再上面才是 DSH 自己的界面。
对话主区的底色被清成透明，于是文字就「透」出来了。

控制端是一个浮在半空的圆点：

| 状态 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 平时 | 一枚半透明小圆点，几乎不占视线 |
| 鼠标悬停 | 展开成按钮条：目录 / 上一章 / ▶ / 下一章 / 书库 / ⚙ / 隐身 |
| 隐身档 | 淡到几乎看不见，但还摸得到（不然就找不回来了） |
| 位置 | 可拖动，位置会被记住 |

> **截图待补。** 仓库目前没有截图，欢迎你装完后自己截两张放进 `assets/`，再按
> [上架规范](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/contributing.md)
> 加一个 `screenshots.json`，市场详情页就会用你自己的图。

---

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kongbai-shike/dsh-novel-wallpaper
```

装完**刷新页面**即可，多数情况下不需要重启。

<details>
<summary>其它安装方式</summary>

**指定 profile：** 把 `--profile web` 换成你的 profile 名（桌面端常见的是 `desktop`）。

**从本地目录开发：** 把仓库软链到 profile 的 `node_modules` 下，再在 profile 的
`package.json` 里登记 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`。DSH 的 HMR 会在你改完
`client.js` 后自动重载客户端半区。

**卸载：** `dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-novel-wallpaper`，或直接在
设置 → 插件里移除。

</details>

**要求：** DSH Web `0.1.0-rc.6` 或更新版本（用到 `shell.overlay` 插槽与客户端快捷键服务）。

---

## 快速开始

1. 把 `.txt` 文件**拖到窗口任意位置**，或点浮窗 → 书库 → `＋`。
2. 在目录里点一章，按 ▶ 开始自动滚动。
3. 滚轮或方向键随时接管；再按 ▶ / ❚❚ 暂停。

**编码是自动识别的**：UTF-8、UTF-8 BOM、UTF-16LE、UTF-16BE，都失败则回退 **GB18030**。
中文 TXT 乱码通常就是缺最后这一步 —— 大部分老书是 GBK/GB18030，不是 UTF-8。

**自动滚动到本章结尾会停住**，不会自己跳下一章。是刻意的：读到哪里由你决定。

---

## 阅读控制：滚轮与方向键

| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 滚轮 ↓ | 往下读（正文上移） |
| 滚轮 ↑ | 往回看（正文下移） |
| `Ctrl + Shift + ↓` | 往下读 |
| `Ctrl + Shift + ↑` | 往回看 |
| `Ctrl + Shift + ←` | 上一章 |
| `Ctrl + Shift + →` | 下一章 |

一次滚轮 / 一次方向键的位移 = **滚动速度 × 滚轮灵敏度**（设置里可调，默认 6×），
约 180ms 缓动到位。连续快滚会**累加**，不会每次都从头重新滑 —— 手感上就是一路滑下去，
而不是一格格地跳。

四条刻意设计的行为：

- **滚轮会「让位」。** 鼠标停在还能滚动的区域（聊天记录、设置面板、目录列表）时，
  滚轮归界面；滚到尽头、或停在空白处时，才轮到小说。所以「把聊天滚到底，接着往下滚」
  就自然滑到小说上，不需要切换模式。
  这条是**必须的**：小说垫在整个界面背后，全局霸占滚轮会让你再也滚不动聊天记录。
- **自动播放时滚一下 = 先暂停**，转手动。
- **隐身档下滚轮和方向键全部失效** —— 老板键的意义就是把屏幕彻底还回去。
- **方向键必须带 `Ctrl + Shift`，且在输入框里永不生效。**
  因为 `Ctrl+Shift+←/→` 是打字时「按词选中」，抢过来只会让编辑更难用；
  焦点在输入框时光标照常移动。

方向键注册在 DSH 自己的**快捷键服务**上，不是全局键盘监听。因此它焦点感知、
会和其它插件做冲突检测、也能在 **DSH 设置 → 快捷键**里改键。命令 id：

```
novel-wallpaper.scroll-up    novel-wallpaper.scroll-down
novel-wallpaper.prev-chapter novel-wallpaper.next-chapter
```

> 方向键在该服务里属于**保留键**，`desktop:windows`、`desktop:macos`、`web:windows`
> 三个平台组合能通过校验，因此只声明了这三个默认绑定。其它平台可以在设置里自己绑。

---

## 老板键

```
Ctrl + Shift + `
```

切「隐身档」：文字不透明度降到 **10%**（即 90% 透明），浮窗淡到几乎看不见，
再按一次恢复。

隐身档的具体数值在设置里可调 —— **把它调成 0，就是彻底还原成原版 DSH 界面**。
隐身档不会被记住，刷新后始终回到正常状态，这样浮窗永远找得回来。

---

## 设置

浮窗 → ⚙。全部设置存在 `localStorage`，只在本机。

| 分组 | 项 |
|---|---|
| 文字 | 字号（默认 34）、文字不透明度（0.18）、跟随主题的字体颜色、字体、行距（1.9）、字间距（0.02） |
| 背景 | 阅读器背景色（`#000000`）、背景浓度（0.35）、界面清底程度（1） |
| 滚动 | 滚动速度（38 px/s）、滚轮灵敏度（6×） |
| 隐身 | 隐身档不透明度（0.1） |
| 阅读 | 显示章节标题、记住阅读进度、分章正则 |
| 预设 | 看得清 / 平衡 / 极隐蔽，一键切换 |

**分章正则**默认是内置规则表里全部「安全」规则的并集，只匹配行首，所以正文里提到
「第一章」不会被误判成新章节。规则表、自动兜底和实测数据见 [分章规则](#分章规则)。

「界面清底程度」是**反着**的：`1` = 把对话区底色完全清掉（文字最清楚，界面也最透）。
调低它，界面会重新变实，小说随之被压暗。

---

## 分章规则

TXT 的分章格式在野外千奇百怪，所以插件内置了一张规则表。默认值就是表里全部
「安全」规则的**并集** —— 拿到一本书直接导入，通常就对了。

| 规则 | 匹配 | 例子 |
|---|---|---|
| 第 N 章 | `第` + 可选空格 + 数字 + 可选空格 + `章节回卷篇` | `第31章 九叔的二徒弟`、`第 31 章`、`第１２章`、`第一回` |
| 卷 / 部 / 篇 | 同上，单位换成 `卷部篇` | `第二卷 风起` |
| 楔子 / 番外 | 常见特殊标题 | `楔子`、`序章`、`引子`、`尾声`、`终章`、`完本感言` |
| 【第 N 章】 | 外层带括号 | `【第12章】降伏`、`（第 13 章）风叔` |
| Chapter N | 英文 | `Chapter 12 Dawn` |

**数字两侧的空格是关键。**`第 31 章 标题` 这种排版在盗版 TXT 里非常常见，而紧贴的
`第N章` 一个都匹配不上 —— 更糟的是它**静默失败**：一本 486 章的书会整本变成一章
「全文」，没有任何地方报错。这一条曾经就是本插件的实际 bug。

**纯数字标题**（`12、开端`、`001.`、`12、`）单列一条规则，但**默认不启用**：行首
孤零零一个数字偶尔是正文，宁可让你在设置里手动点一下。

### 自动兜底

如果当前正则在你的书上匹配不到章节（标题少于 2 个），插件会把每条内置规则都试一遍，
按「命中数最多、且标题大多是短行」挑一条最好的，然后：

- 用它重新分章；
- 在状态栏写明用的是哪条规则 —— **不会偷偷无视你手写的正则**。

判定时会要求至少一半的命中行是短行（≤ 40 字）——整段正文不可能符合。如果所有规则的
「标题」都是整段正文，它宁可不猜，保持原样：猜错比不分章更糟。

### 换规则不用重新导入

设置里改完分章正则会**立刻**按新规则重新分章，并写回书库。正则框下面是一排内置规则，
点一下直接套用；也可以手写任意正则。

显示的标题会先清洗一遍：

- `第 31 章 九叔的二徒弟` → `第31章 九叔的二徒弟`（数字与单位之间的空格去掉）；
- `【第12章】标题` → `第12章 标题`（拆括号）；
- 标题和正文首段挤在同一行时（`第1章 标题　　正文…`）只保留标题。

### 实测

《同穿：我的名字响彻诸天》（3.0 MB / 106 万字）：

| | 分章数 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 修复前 | **1** | 整本变成一章「全文」，106 万字滚不到头 |
| 修复后 | **482** | 前言 + 481 章正文，标题最长 22 字，正文零丢失 |

> 那本书章节号编到 486，但第 119 / 166 / 167 / 371 / 439 章**源文件里就没有**
> （盗版 TXT 常见的丢章），不是分章出错。插件分出的 481 章，就是文件里真实存在的全部。

---

## 隐私

**纯客户端插件。** host 侧的 `apply()` 是空的。

- 正文存在浏览器 **IndexedDB**（TXT 动辄 5–20MB，`localStorage` 会直接爆配额）
- 进度和设置存在 **localStorage**
- **不写 session log、不注册任何工具、不给模型任何入口**

也就是说：**agent 在结构上读不到你在看什么。** 不是「我们承诺不看」，是那条路根本没修。
所有解析、分章、渲染都在浏览器里完成，不经过网络。

---

## 兼容性

- 面向 **DSH Web GUI**（浏览器里的 `dsh web`，以及内嵌同一套界面的桌面客户端）。
- 实际运行验证于 DSH Web `0.1.7-rc.2`（React 18.3.1）；最低要求 `0.1.0-rc.6`。
- 透明效果**纯靠 CSS**：清空 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 这类不透明底色让下层透出来，
  不依赖系统亚克力/毛玻璃，所以 Windows 上壳层材质设为 `off` 也照样工作。
- 和 `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` **不叠加**：本插件不透出图片壁纸。两个都想用，
  需要把本层的 `z-index` 抬到图片壁纸层之上。

---

## 设计取舍

有些地方看着「不够聪明」，其实是故意的：

**为什么滚轮不直接霸占全局？**
因为小说在**所有东西背后**。一个全局 `wheel` 监听会把聊天记录、设置面板、目录列表的
滚动全部吃掉 —— 那是不能接受的。所以做的是仲裁：从鼠标下的节点往上走，只要有一层
还能朝那个方向滚，就还给界面；都没得滚了，才轮到小说。代价是多走一次 DOM 链，
收益是两套滚动共存而不打架。

**为什么章节读到底不自动进下一章？**
自动跳章意味着你低头回个消息，回来已经读丢了。停在章末，是安全的那一侧。

**为什么方向键要带修饰键，而不是直接上下左右？**
不带修饰键的话，聊天框里按 ↑ 会去翻小说而不是翻输入历史，光标也会跳。
窄的收益配宽的破坏，不划算 —— 所以必须组合键，且 `editable` 区域直接不注册。

**为什么快滚要累加而不是重新开始？**
第一版每次滚动都从「上一次动画的起点」重新算，连滚时每一格都在把之前的进度抹掉，
表现为「滚得越快越不动」。现在改从**当前已画出来的位置**重新瞄准，
所以连续输入会叠成一段连贯的滑动。

---

## 开发

```sh
node test/logic.test.mjs      # 解码 / 分章 / 字典覆盖 / 配色        24 项
node test/apply.smoke.mjs     # 载入 / 壁纸层 / 滚动 / 滚轮 / 快捷键   35 项（带 DOM stub）
```

两个都是零依赖的 `node` 脚本，直接跑，不需要装任何东西。
`apply.smoke.mjs` 自己搭了一套最小 DOM stub，能覆盖透明的绘制路径、滚轮的边界与仲裁、
快捷键注册的形状，以及销毁时是否留下残留。

**目录结构：**

```
client.js          # 全部逻辑：壁纸层、浮窗、阅读引擎、设置面板（浏览器半区）
index.js           # host 半区，apply() 为空
cordis.patch.yml   # dsh.bundle 清单，把插件挂进 DSH
test/              # 两个零依赖测试
```

改动集中在 `client.js`。它是一个 `factory(require)` 闭包，React 通过 `h = createElement`
使用，`__internals` 导出给无头测试用。

---

## 已知限制

- 只有**对话主区**被清成透明；侧边栏保持不透明（更隐蔽，也不影响可读性）。
  想让侧栏也透，需要在 `LAYER_CSS` 里补 `.dshDesktopSidebarSurface` 的规则。
- 目录一次性渲染全部章节。上万章的巨型文本可能略有卡顿。
- 阅读进度按书 + 章节记，跨设备不同步（本来也不该同步 —— 正文只存在本机）。
- 没有图片/EPUB 支持，只有 TXT。这是取舍：TXT 解析能全在本地跑完，不留任何网络请求。

---

## 反馈与贡献

- **Bug / 功能建议**：直接开 [issue](https://github.com/kongbai-shike/dsh-novel-wallpaper/issues)。
  带上你的 DSH 版本、操作系统，以及「怎么复现」。
- **PR**：欢迎。改动前先跑一遍上面两个测试；新增行为请顺手补一条用例 ——
  这个仓库的测试是零依赖的，加一条成本很低。

---

## ⭐ 如果它对你的胃口

这个插件的起点很朴素：**我想在等模型回话的时候，顺手看两页小说，又不想多开一个窗口。**

如果你也有过这个念头，那它大概就是为你写的。

**我希望能收获你的一颗 Star。** 它不会让我赚到什么，但会让我知道
「原来不只我一个人需要这个」—— 也就有理由继续把还欠着的地方磨下去：
更细的滚轮手感、更好的大字排版、多书并行、目录分卷。

一颗星，就是一个「继续做」的理由。谢谢。

---

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

给 **DSH 桌面端**（DeepSeek Harness / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop`）用的小插件合集 —— **一个插件一个目录**。

> A collection of small DSH desktop plugins. One plugin per directory.

## 插件清单

| 目录 | 包名 | 一句话 | 安装规格 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`packages/dsh-focus-composer`](packages/dsh-focus-composer) | `dsh-focus-composer` | `Ctrl+I` 把光标送回输入框 | `github:Yaoxxxxxxx/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-focus-composer` |

## 安装某个插件

**市场里装**：把上面表格里的「安装规格」填进去（`github:owner/repo#path:/子目录` 就是 pnpm 的子目录选择器）。

**本机开发用**（不经过网络）：

```bash
pnpm add "link:<本仓库路径>/packages/<插件目录>" --dir <你的 profile 目录>
```

装完把包名加进该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`；带客户端半边的插件官方口径是**刷新一次页面**生效。

## 目录约定

```
dsh-plugins/
├── package.json          # workspace 根（private，不发布，没有 dsh 声明）
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
├── README.md             # 这份：插件索引
└── packages/
    └── <plugin-name>/    # 一个插件一个目录，目录名 = 包名
        ├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 双声明
        ├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载行（只写纯 insert，市场热挂载只认这种）
        ├── lib/index.js          # 宿主半边（没事干就空实现）
        ├── lib/client.js         # 客户端半边（必须 __ModuleLoader__ 包装，不是 ESM）
        └── README.md             # 这个插件自己的说明
```

## 加一个新插件

1. 复制 `packages/dsh-focus-composer` 当骨架，改 `package.json` 的 `name` / `version` / `description` /
   `repository.directory`，以及 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `id` 与 `name`
2. **`id` 必须全仓库唯一** —— 两个插件用同一个行 id 会触发 duplicate loader entry，宿主直接起不来
3. 提交前自查客户端半边：`new Function(src)` 不抛异常、**没有顶层 `import` / `export`**、
   用的是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` 包装
4. 在本文档的「插件清单」表里补一行

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 插件：在工具调用层强制「先委派给其他模型」——未派发的会话无法执行 pwsh/write/edit。⚠️ 本插件会拦截工具调用（这是设计目标）；含举证式放行、行为账本与一键停用开关。
plugins.readme_text:
# 派发闸门 (Dispatch Gate) · DSH 插件

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.1.7-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)

> ## ⚠️ 装之前必须知道：**本插件会拦截你的工具调用**
>
> 启用后，只要某个会话「**还没有任何派发记录**」，它就**无法执行**：
> `pwsh` · `write` · `edit` · `ego_*` 执行族 · 以及 `web_search` 等查资料工具。
>
> **这不是 bug，这就是本插件的全部意义** —— 逼 AI 先把活派给别的模型，再自己动手。
>
> | 你的情况 | 怎么办 |
> |---|---|
> | **只是想试试 / 觉得被拦得难受** | 把配置里的 **`enforce` 改成 `false`**，或在 DSH 里**禁用/卸载本插件** → **立刻恢复** |
> | **你是 AI 助手的使用者** | 装对了。你的助手从此会先派活再动手 —— 这正是设计目标 |
> | **不确定要不要装** | ✅ **先读「它解决什么问题」那节**，再决定 |
>
> **一句话**：这是**行为约束插件**，不是能力增强插件。它**故意让你少一些自由**。

---

> **一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在工具调用层强制「先委派给其他模型」。**
>
> 本会话没有派发记录时，**无法执行 `pwsh` / `write` / `edit` 与查资料工具** ——
> 让「把活派出去」从**提示词纪律**变成**物理约束**。

---

## 它解决什么问题

用多模型协作时，AI 助手会**倾向于自己埋头干**，而不是把活派给更便宜/更合适的模型。
写提示词、加规则、做检查表 —— 实测**连续失败 3 次**（规则越写越多，执行照旧）。

**根本原因**：规则是"提醒"，而提醒在长上下文里会被稀释。

**这个插件的思路**：**不在提示词层劝，而是在工具调用层拦** ——
`ctx.tools.guard()` 是同步单调守卫，拦截了就是拦截了，没有"再劝一次"的空间。

---

## 前置要求

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| **DSH**（DeepSeek Harness） | **>= 0.1.7**（这是 DSH 插件，**离开 DSH 无法运行**） |
| Node.js | >= 20 |

> ⚠️ **重要**：本插件依赖 DSH 的 Cordis 插件体系与 `tools` 注入环境。
> 它不是通用中间件 —— **没有 DSH 请勿安装**。

---

## 它拦什么 / 不拦什么

**拦**（自己动手类）：
- `pwsh` / `write` / `edit`
- `ego_*` 执行族（`ego_script` / `ego_cli` / `ego_js` / `ego_cdp` / …，**前缀匹配**，含未来新增）
- 自己查资料：`web_search` / `web_fetch` / `argo_search` / `argo_fetch` / `read_page` / `x_search` / `wide_research`
- `ego_*` 取数族（`ego_http` / `ego_navigate` / `ego_snapshot` / …）

**不拦**：
- 翻文件：`read` / `grep` / `glob`
- 派发本身：`workflow` / `subagent` / `task_board_run` 等
- 命令本体以 `model-hub.mjs` 之类的**调度脚本**发起的调用（见下方配置）

---

## 放行的 6 个条件（按序短路，命中任一即放行）

| # | 条件 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| ① | **派发本身** | 解析式判据：去注释 → 分段 → 引号感知分词 → 首 token 是 `node` 且某非引号 token 以目标脚本结尾 |
| ② | **举证式 SELF-DO** | 见下节（v10 核心） |
| ③ | **子代理会话** | 由 `subagent/start` / `workflow/agent-start` 权威事件精确识别（子代理**没有**派发能力，故豁免） |
| ④ | **同一派发根调用** | 派发动作带出的一系列后续调用 |
| ⑤ | **兜底时间窗** | 距本会话最近一次派发 < `subagentGraceMs`（默认 10s，per-agent） |
| ⑥ | **本会话已成功派发** | 放行与计数**解耦**：假派发不解锁 |

---

## 举证式 SELF-DO（v10 核心机制）

**为什么需要它**：v9 只要求"写上 `SELF-DO: <理由>`"就放行 —— 于是**随手写一句就能绕过整个闸门**。

**v10 改成举证式**：必须拿出**证据**。三种合格写法（**只认关键参数本体**：`pwsh`→`command`，`write`/`edit`→`file_path`）：

```text
# A) 权限型自办 —— 权限只在人手里（跑本机命令 / 高风险写操作 / 改配置 / 删文件 / 动 git）
SELF-DO: perm=<pwsh|high-risk|privilege>; reason=<为何权限只在你手里>

# B) 结构化证据 —— 声明派给过谁 + 对方为何干不了（缺一不可）
SELF-DO: tried=<派给了谁，如 zhipu,modelscope>; reason=<对方为何干不了/为何必须你来>

# C) 本会话真的派过一次（成功或失败都算）
SELF-DO: <一句话理由>      ← 前提：本会话 dispatch>0 或 dispatchFailed>0
```

三者都不满足 → **fail-closed 拒绝**，并给出**可操作指引**（不是"你不能这么干"，而是"你该这么干"）。
拦截原因会分类记录：`no-dispatch-record` / `selfdo-no-evidence` / `guard-error`。

> **写在别处一律无效**：`justification`、`content`、`old_string`、`new_string` 里的 `SELF-DO:` **不算** —— 这是 fail-closed 的正确行为，但**极易误解**，请注意。

**回滚开关**：`requireDispatchEvidence: false` 可退回 v9 的声明式语义（仅应急，勿常开）。

---

## 安装

本插件是 **DSH bundle 插件**，通过 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `bundle.patch` 挂载：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dispatch-gate
      name: '@alankhronos/dsh-dispatch-gate'
      config:
        # 见下方「配置项」
```

然后用 DSH 的插件管理安装（`plugin_manager install_bundle`，target 指向本包）。
> ⚠️ 开发时建议用 **`link:`** 方式安装 —— 这样改源码即时生效（否则 Node 的 ESM 缓存按**绝对路径**为键，原地改代码不会重载）。

---

## 配置项

只改 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config:` 段，**无需改源码**：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `workTools` | `['pwsh','write','edit']` | 自己动手类工具 |
| `workToolPrefixes` | `['ego_']` | 前缀匹配的工具族 |
| `researchTools` | `['web_search', …]` | 自己查资料类工具 |
| `delegationTools` | `['workflow','subagent',…]` | 派发本身（不拦） |
| `dispatchPatterns` | 见源码 | 派发命令的解析规则 |
| `subagentGraceMs` | `10000` | 兜底时间窗（per-agent） |
| `guardFailClosed` | `true` | guard 内部异常时是否拒绝（保守策略） |
| **`requireDispatchEvidence`** | `true` | **v10 举证开关**；`false` 退回声明式 |
| **`permKeywords`** | `['perm','privilege','high-risk']` | 权限型通道的关键词 |
| `logDir` | `<系统临时目录>/dispatch-gate` | 账本与日志目录 |

---

## 行为账本

每次放行/拦截都会追加一行到 `logDir/dispatch-stats.jsonl`：

| kind | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `dispatch` | 成功派发 |
| `selfdo` | 自办放行（走 ②/⑤/⑥） |
| `research` | 直查资料放行 |
| `blocked` | **被拦截**（含 `reason` 与 `evidence` 快照，便于审计） |
| `selfdo-permit` | **带证据放行**（含 `via` 与 `evidence`，可追溯是哪条通道） |
| `dispatch-failed` | 派发尝试失败（**失败也算证据**） |

---

## 测试

```bash
npm test        # 等价于 node selftest.mjs
```

**56 项用例**（55 PASS / 0 FAIL / **1 SKIP**）。

> `SKIP` 的那项是「与 v7/v8 的行为对照测试」—— 它需要**相邻目录存在历史版本**才跑；
> 本仓库只发布 v10，因此该项优雅跳过（**不是失败**）。

---

## 迭代史（v1 → v10）

每一版都是**被真实测试打出来的**（不是设计出来的）：

| 版本 | 修了什么 |
|---|---|
| v1–v5 | 从"能拦 pwsh"到"不误伤自己派出去的子代理"（改用 `tools/pre-execute` 提前开豁免窗） |
| v6 | 跨会话泄漏 · 拦截清单配置化 · guard 异常 fail-closed |
| v7 | 6 个缺陷：echo 绕过 / `turn/end` 死代码 / 计数虚高 / 时间窗误豁免 / 兜底窗残留 / cwd bug |
| v8 | 4 个绕过：**假派发永久解锁** / **`ego_*` 能力级后门** / 误判静默失效 / `SELF-DO` 全文匹配 + 3 个运维陷阱 |
| v9 | 2 个遗留点：**拦截不入账**（新增 `blocked`）/ 子代理被误判违规 |
| **v10** | **`SELF-DO` 从「声明式」升级为「举证式」** + 补回滚开关 |

**教训的核心**：**规则越写越多，执行照旧** —— 因为"提醒"依赖被提醒者自觉。
**结构约束才有效**：把它做成"不派发就干不了活"。

---

## 已知限制（诚实声明）

- **强依赖 DSH** —— 离开 DSH 无法运行（这是设计使然，不是缺陷）
- **只在本会话内生效**：状态按 agent 隔离，新会话从零开始
- **只拦"工具调用"这一层** —— 若模型用别的途径（如直接写文件的其他工具）绕过，需要把该工具加进 `workTools`
- **不做内容判断** —— 它只看"你有没有派发"，不评价派发质量
- **3 项历史对照测试在本仓库会 SKIP**（缺 v7/v8 目录）
- 项目定位是**个人工作流的结构化约束**，不是通用 Agent 治理框架

---

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 AlanKhronos

plugins.description: DSH 分层记忆与自我进化插件：记忆/技能/待办/通知/COI 调度/会话广播/书签/记忆同步/无限画板/Advisor 评审，带 WebUI 管理界面。Memory, skills, todos and self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-memory-evolve 使用场景指南

> **一句话**：让 DSH 里的 AI 拥有跨会话的长期记忆、帮你管理待办与技能、还能拉起一群 AI 会话和外部 AI 代理协同干活——**越用越懂你，换会话不丢上下文**。
>
> 本指南按真实工作流组织，每个场景讲「适合谁、能做什么、怎么用、会得到什么」。
>
> 相关文档：[详细功能说明](README-详细说明.md) · [记忆同步](docs/记忆同步.md) · [更新日志](docs/CHANGELOG.md) · [English](README.en.md)

---

## 认识它（30 秒）

装上插件后，打开任意会话，你会多出一排能力标签：**记忆 · 技能 · 待办 · 无限画板 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 提示词 · 记忆同步 · 模型设置 · 书签 · 会话评审 · Web UI 设置 · Memory Evolve 设置**。AI 侧则多了一批工具：记忆读写、待办、技能管理、本地文件搜索、会话编排、会话广播、外部 AI 派单、提示词注入、模型查询……

一句话概括这些能力：**让 AI 记住你、替你管、替你做、互相配合做。**

> 小提示：插件里很多能力默认关闭（不占 AI 的工具清单），需要时在「Memory Evolve 设置」里打开即可。下面的场景大多是组合玩法——**把相关功能都打开，才能串成完整的流水线**。

---

## 场景一：让 AI 真正记住你（长期记忆）

**适合谁**：所有人。这是插件的核心，也是其他一切功能的地基。

AI 的对话是「一次性」的：换项目、隔几天、开新会话，它就忘了你是谁。插件的五轨记忆让 AI 拥有**跨会话的长期工作记忆**：

- **用户档案**：你的偏好、公司、沟通习惯——AI 每回合都能看到；
- **全局事实**：环境、工具、惯例等长期知识；
- **项目关键记忆**：当前项目的约定、决策、架构、踩坑，自动注入上下文，重要结论可标记**只在某个 git 分支生效**；
- **项目日志 / 每日日志**：每回合自动记录进展，按需读取，历史可追溯。

**怎么用**：

1. 正常和 AI 对话即可——每回合结束时它会自动把进展写进项目日志和今日日志；
2. 发现重要事实时对它说「**记一下：这个项目的部署端口是 8080**」，它会写入项目关键记忆，**你确认后**才生效——AI 不会擅自往记忆里写东西；
3. 过几天、换了个会话，直接问「**查一下记忆，上次我们定下的架构决策是什么**」——它能无缝衔接；
4. 记忆多了之后，让 AI「**把 XX 那条记忆归档**」——归档条目不再注入上下文，随时可转回；
5. **情绪反馈记录**：你对工作结果的评价（如「太好了」「怎么还没改对」）会被 AI 记入当日与项目日志（`【反馈】` 行，含情绪、任务分类、你的原话）——积累后随时可以让 AI「**分析一下最近我对哪些方面不满意**」，判断它在哪类任务上做得好/不好。

**会得到什么**：AI 从一个「每次会话都失忆」的对话机器，变成了解你全盘工作的长期伙伴——隔天继续开发，它直接引用昨天的结论，不用你复述。

## 场景：多台电脑共享项目记忆（记忆同步）

**适合谁**：办公室和家里两台电脑干活、或有同事协作同一个项目的人——不想在每台电脑上把重要结论重新讲一遍。

**怎么用**（详见 [记忆同步](docs/记忆同步.md)）：

1. 「Memory Evolve 设置 → 配置」打开「**记忆同步**」模块开关（这只是让功能可见）；
2. 在项目会话的「**记忆同步**」Tab 打开「**本项目同步**」——点「开始同步」即可（记忆远端默认用你的代码仓库，自动存进专属分支，不污染代码），再点「同步并推送」完成首次推送；**代码公开（如 GitHub 开源）但记忆想私藏**？填一个**共享记忆仓库**地址——一个仓库装所有项目的记忆（每项目一条专属分支），记忆与代码彻底隔离；
3. 另一台电脑 clone 项目后打开——**自动认亲**（同一仓库地址 = 同一项目），拉下来即可继续用；
4. 平时照常写记忆（实时落盘、零延迟），攒一批点一次「同步」；两台电脑都改了同一条记忆才会出现冲突，Tab 里选「采用本机 / 采用远端 / 两者都要」即可。

**会得到什么**：项目关键记忆、项目日志、归档、项目待办跨设备一致；填了共享记忆仓库后，**全局记忆（用户档案/每日日志/待办）也能跨设备**（四个独立轨开关，开哪个同步哪个）——换电脑不换记忆。**没开同步的项目完全不受影响**（保持纯本地状态）。

## 场景二：多项目并行开发，每件事都不丢（待办 + 项目日志 + 本地搜索）

**适合谁**：同时维护多个项目、经常被「之前那个方案是怎么定的」卡住的开发者。

- **四轨待办**：生活 / 工作 / 项目 / 每日。「项目」轨按工作目录隔离，换目录互不干扰。说「**记住，周五前把二级面板部署到手机访问实例**」，自动落成项目待办（带重要/紧急、截止日期）；每天收尾 AI 会提醒你到期的待办；
- **项目日志**：每个项目的进展按目录隔离沉淀，日志自动带 `[git main]` 分支标记，可溯源；
- **本地文件搜索**：对 AI 说「**搜一下本机有没有写过类似的东西**」——按文件名找文档（可扩展到全类型）；也能内容检索：「**哪个文档里提过 XX**」直接返回命中文件和片段。

**怎么用**：

1. 新项目开工直接开聊，项目日志自动建档；
2. 冒出的想法对 AI 说「记住」，它会进待确认队列——到「待办」里**采纳或拒绝**，你说了算；
3. 想不起来就问「之前有个文档提到过 XX」。

**会得到什么**：同时开 3 个项目也不乱——每个项目的记忆、待办、文档线索各归各的目录，问一句就能捡起来。

## 场景三：一个人指挥一群 AI 干活（内部团队）

**适合谁**：想把 AI 用成「团队」的人——一个主会话指挥美工、前端、后端、测试多个子会话。

**怎么用**：

1. **拉起团队**：对主会话的 AI 说「**创建 4 个会话：美工负责网站视觉、前端负责页面、后端负责接口、测试负责验收，把它们拉进同一个协作房间**」——它立刻创建 4 个标准会话（出现在左侧列表、随时可接管），自动继承你的模型与工作目录；创建时可指定 **Agent 预设**（如「用代码模式创建前端会话」），决定该会话的工具面与人格；
2. **协作沟通**：房间建好后，**谁改了什么、谁干完了，全员可见**；成员状态（正在生成 / 空闲）变化会自动收到「房间动态」通知；**房间消息可以带图片**——截图直接发群里，接收方 AI 通过 read 拿到图片文件路径，可读图、可转发到 IM 渠道；
3. **派活与催活**：问 AI「**现在谁在干活、谁空闲了**」，它会查看各会话状态；对空闲的会话说「**叫前端把结果发过来**」，AI 自动唤醒它并派活——不会批量自动唤醒，一切由你（或你的主会话）有意识地指挥；
4. **防冲突**：同一项目多个会话并行改代码时，开工前对 AI 说「**声明一下你要改哪些文件**」——其他人（及其 AI）能看到「谁在改什么」；真撞车了，写入方会收到冲突警告，还有「工作区活动」通知（并行开始/结束、成员变化时单独推送）随时告知谁在跑、在干什么；
5. **结果回传**：各成员干完把结果发回房间，你汇总确认。

**持续运转（关键）**：主会话自己一直在运行，所以它能**随时唤醒已经休息（空闲）的会话继续干活**——催活、收结果、派下一轮，哪怕你不在电脑前，队伍也能一路推进到出结果。唯一的前提是**主会话所在的 DSH 进程保持运行**；如果主会话空闲了或 DSH 被关掉，唤醒链就停了——需要你回来发一条消息，队伍重新开动。

**会得到什么**：一个人的开发产出，变成一个小团队的吞吐。任务交接、唤醒、冲突预警全链路自动化，房间消息留痕可查。

## 场景四：重活派给外部 AI 代理（外部外援）

**适合谁**：需要把大任务（视觉重设计、代码审查、完整功能开发）交给专用 AI 代理（Kimi / Codex / Grok / Hermes）的用户——不想被阻塞，又不想错过结果。

**怎么用**：

1. 对 AI 说「**把这个任务派给 grok：移动端适配改造**」——后台异步执行，立即返回任务号，**不卡当前会话**，你可以继续聊别的；
2. 期间随时问「**任务进度如何**」，或在「COI 调度」里看实时日志流；
3. 派单时 AI 可自主选择带上你的项目记忆——外部代理也「懂项目约定」；
4. **派单可以带图**：对 AI 说「**把这张截图发给 grok 分析**」——附件支持本地路径/远程 URL/本会话图片（你在输入框贴的图），codex/kimi/hermes 都能真看图（grok 走 prompt 读图，zcode 纯文本会明确拒绝）；
5. 完成后结果摘要**自动写入项目日志与今日日志**——派出去的活自动变成你的记忆资产。

**会得到什么**：AI 派活给 AI，你只负责确认验收。视觉改版、深度代码审查、批量重构这类「重活」都能甩出去，主会话保持轻快。

## 场景五：内外协同——一支队伍，两种兵种

**适合谁**：任务大到单靠一边搞不定的人。这是插件协作能力的完全体：**内部会话负责「需要上下文和来回打磨的活」，外部代理负责「一次性重活」，两者通过记忆、房间、提示词串成一条流水线。**

一个完整的真实流程（产品视觉改版）：

1. **分工**：主会话 spawn 前端、测试两个内部会话并拉进房间；同时把「全站视觉重设计」派给外部代理 Kimi；
2. **外部主刀**：Kimi 后台跑重设计（不占任何会话）；期间内部前端会话先做数据层和页面结构，不干等；
3. **接力**：Kimi 完成，摘要自动沉淀进项目记忆——主会话把设计结论发到房间，前端会话**读记忆拿到设计规范**，开始集成；
4. **问题升级**：集成中发现一个诡异样式问题，前端会话卡住——主会话把这个 bug 派给 Grok 深挖，结论回房间，前端会话照结论修复；
5. **验收**：测试会话跑完验收流程，结果发回房间，你最后确认。

协作的四个结合点，可以自由组合：

- **任务接力**：外部代理的产出（摘要/结论）自动进记忆 → 内部会话接力执行——**外部做重活，内部做集成与打磨**；
- **问题升级**：内部会话遇到难啃的问题 → 主会话派给外部代理深挖 → 结论回房间——**内部快节奏迭代，外部慢工出细活**；
- **标准统一**：给外部代理派活时，注入你沉淀的提示词（如「代码审查清单」「PRD 规范」）——**外部代理按你的流程干活，不靠运气**；
- **状态同步**：谁在跑、谁干完了，房间 + 工作区活动 + 通知随时可见——**你不用当人肉调度员**。

**会得到什么**：一条「外部主刀 → 内部集成 → 测试验收 → 你确认」的完整流水线。大任务不再是一个人（或一个 AI）硬扛，而是内外两支队伍分工协作。

## 场景六：AI 的自我纪律——提示词注入

**适合谁**：想把「好用的工作方法」沉淀下来、让每个 AI（包括外部代理）都按同一套流程干活的人。

提示词库是**指令范式资产库**：代码审查、调试、PRD、测试策略……把常用的工作方法固化成提示词（可分类、可搜索、可启用/禁用）。

**怎么用**：

1. **AI 自己选、自己注入**：AI 觉得当前任务适用某套流程时，它会自己查看提示词库、选中合适的提示词注入自己——「接下来按代码审查清单执行」；下一轮它自动遵循，**不打断当前回复**；也能「立即注入」，当前回合马上生效；
2. **你一键注入**：在「提示词注入」里选中一条，点「注入一次 / 持续注入 / 立即注入」——持续注入就是「每回合提醒 AI 按此纪律干活」；
3. **临时注入**：不建提示词，直接输入一段要求注入，自动存入库中，下次复用；
4. **派活带纪律**：给子会话、外部代理派活时，让 AI 把对应提示词一起带上——**整个团队用同一套标准**。

**会得到什么**：好方法不再只存在你脑子里或一次对话里——它变成可复用的「团队操作手册」，AI 会主动遵守，你只管维护手册质量。

---

## 场景七：会话太长、太贵、容易糊——书签与分支

**适合谁**：对上下文开销敏感、一个会话动辄上百轮的深度用户。

- **会话书签**：每一轮都可以点星（☆）标记，「书签」列出全部书签（名称/轮次/时间/摘要，可搜索），**点击一键跳回任意一轮**——探索到「这个结论很重要」就打个星；
- **任意轮分支**：官方只支持从最后一轮创建分支；本插件把**中间任意轮的分支入口接管**——书签列表点「分支」（或直接点官方分支按钮，中间轮会弹出确认），走官方分支通道创建新会话，进入官方分支谱系；
- **上下文占用提醒**：输入框圆环实时显示上下文占用——≥30% 变黄、≥40% 变红，提醒你该打书签、该开分支、该开新会话了。

**怎么用**：

1. 探索性会话在关键轮次点 ☆，给书签起个名字（如「方案 A 评审结论」）；
2. 想从中间某个决策点另开一条线，书签列表点「分支」；
3. 看到圆环变红，把当前会话打个书签，开新会话继续。

**会得到什么**：上下文不再是一根只能从头滚到尾的绳子，而是**带锚点、可分支、可跳转的时间线**——每一轮的探索成果都能被精准复用，不会再因为「会话太长了」被迫放弃中间的好结论。

---

## 场景八：离开电脑也能用（手机访问 + 会话筛选 + 通知）

**适合谁**：离开电脑也想继续和 AI 协作、或者同时开很多会话看不过来的人。

- **手机浏览器访问**：DSH 界面适配了手机——对话区/消息气泡满宽、输入栏「⋯」上拉收纳工具栏与模型选择，手机上操作和电脑端一致；
- **会话列表筛选**：左侧列表可只显示「进行中的会话」，一屏看清谁在干活——桌面端同样适用；
- **渠道通知（de_notify）**：对 AI 说「任务完成用飞书通知我」，重要结果推到飞书/QQ/微信/企业微信，电脑前/手机上立刻知道（通知内容带「这是通知」标注，可附图片/文件）；
- **web 站内通知（de_notify channels=web）**：对 AI 说「发个站内通知给我」，通知直接落到**网页右上角的铃铛**——未读数字徽标 + 弹窗列表，能看到「哪个会话发来什么」，点主题跳转到那个会话、长内容点「查看详情」打开大弹窗看全文；铃铛可随意拖动、松手吸附到屏幕左/右边缘（位置记忆）。发到 web 和发到飞书等 IM 是同一句话，只是换个送达目的地（channels 传 `web`，或 `all` 一起发）；
- **渠道直发（de_channel_send）**：AI 随时主动把文本/图片/文件发到你的 IM 渠道（不带通知标注）——「把生成的图片/文档发给我」类场景；四个渠道（飞书/QQ/微信/企微）全部支持，附件来源可选本地路径/远程 URL/内联 base64/**本会话图片**（sessionImage=true 直接转发你在 DSH 输入框粘贴/拖入发送的图；attachmentId 显式引用，配合 de_session_images 先查本会话有哪些图，需 DSH 260810+ 快照）。

**会得到什么**：重活照派、进度照盯，人不用守在电脑前——回电脑后从左侧列表接管会话继续。

## 场景九：给每个会话配一个隐形评审员（会话评审）

**适合谁**：想让 AI 干活时有一双"第二眼睛"把关、又不想自己逐句盯的人——尤其是项目里定了纪律（如"回复前先说明自己在哪个目录"）却总发现 AI 聊着聊着就忘了的情况。

**能做什么**：

- **独立评审员**：给每个会话挂一个独立的评审会话，它**只观察你在界面上看到的对话**（用户说的话 + Agent 的回复正文），看不到思考过程、工具调用参数等内部细节——像旁边坐了一位只旁听对话、不碰键盘的同事；
- **每轮实时评审**：对话每推进一轮，评审员就基于**完整上下文**评审一次——它是持续会话，像普通 LLM 长对话一样记住全部历史、**永不截断**，不会"忘了前面说过什么"；
- **需要时实时提醒（steer）**：评审员发现值得说的点，会以**用户指令的形式**注入当前会话——Agent 会把它当成你说的话直接执行（2026-08-13 拍板：实测带"非用户指令"标记会让 Agent 质疑来源、执行力下降，所以伪装成用户指令效果最好）；GUI 对话流中这类消息显示为**折叠行 `[severity]` 前缀**，方便你一眼认出哪些话其实是评审员说的；
- **四级严重度**：`info`（仅记录、默认不注入主会话，可配置注入）/ `nit`（小建议）/ `concern`（值得处理）/ `blocker`（必须立即处理）——不是所有话都打断，只有该说的才说；
- **新建评审会话**：面板里一键清空评审员的上下文与记忆重来——新会话第一条指令由你告诉它背景，上下文长度由你掌控；
- **直接向评审员提问**：面板里随时提问，它立即回答（回答只在评审面板展示，不注入主会话流）——像随时可以问的旁听同事；
- **四层级约束**：系统提示词（全局默认，可查看全文/修改/一键恢复）/ **项目约束**（本工作区共享）/ **会话约束**（本会话保留）/ **本次评审会话约束**（随"新建评审会话"清空）——四层拼接注入，冲突时越局部越优先；
- **记录可查**：评审记录 JSONL 持久化，面板「记录」可追溯。

**怎么用**：

1. 「Memory Evolve 设置 → 配置」打开「**会话评审**」（`advisorEnabled`，默认关闭）；评审模型缺省继承当前会话模型，也可单独配置 `advisorProvider`/`advisorModel`；
2. 会话页出现「会话评审」悬浮窗，点开面板即可看到评审员的实时评审流与上下文占用；
3. 在「约束」Tab 给评审员立规矩（如项目约束："每次回复前先说明自己在哪个目录"），保存立即生效；
4. 想让评审员重头开始就点「**新建评审会话**」；想直接问它就点「**提问**」；
5. Agent 侧：评审提醒以折叠行 `[severity]` 出现在对话流里——你能看到评审员说了什么、Agent 是否照做。

**会得到什么**：每个 AI 会话都多了一位持续在岗的"旁听同事"——它不打断你的节奏，只在关键时刻以你的口吻提醒 Agent 纠偏；项目纪律、会话约束有人替你盯着，不会聊着聊着就忘了规矩。

## 场景十：散落的素材，一块画板装下（无限画板）

plugins.description: DSH speech-to-text provider that runs SenseVoiceSmall on the Intel NPU via OpenVINO
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sensevoice-npu

Local speech-to-text for DSH that runs **SenseVoiceSmall on the Intel NPU**
through OpenVINO, plugged into the official voice-input stack.

It registers one more provider into the stock
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-speech-to-text` service, so the voice-input
button, the settings card, the preparation UI and the speech API keep working
unchanged — only the recognizer behind them changes.

## Why a separate plugin

The bundled provider (`dsh-experimental-speech-to-text-sensevoice`) is CPU-only
by construction:

* `lib/worker.js` hard-codes `provider: "cpu"` for the recognizer and the VAD;
* the shipped `sherpa-onnx-win-x64` package is a CPU-only ONNX Runtime build, so
  sherpa-onnx's `openvino` provider logs *"OpenVINOExecutionProvider is not
  available … Fallback to cpu"*;
* ONNX Runtime publishes no OpenVINO build for Windows;
* and OpenVINO **crashes** the NPU compiler on this model's default graph
  (unbounded dynamic dimensions from the `x_length` attention mask).

This plugin sidesteps all four: it bakes `x_length` into a constant for one
frame bucket (which the NPU compiler accepts), compiles that graph for the NPU,
and serves it through a small Python worker.

## Layout

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | cordis plugin: registers the provider, spawns the worker, runs preparation |
| `lib/worker.py` | authenticated loopback HTTP worker (one WAV per request) |
| `lib/sensevoice_npu.py` | frontend (fbank + LFR + CMVN), Silero VAD, NPU session, CTC decode |
| `runtime/bootstrap.ps1` | creates the virtual environment the worker needs |

The frontend mirrors sherpa-onnx exactly: `kaldi_native_fbank` with the same
options, `ApplyLfr` (7/6), and `(x + neg_mean) * inv_stddev` with the CMVN
vectors read from the ONNX metadata — so transcripts match the CPU provider.

## Install

### Prerequisite: model files

The worker reads three files (this plugin does **not** download models — it registers with an empty `downloadSources`):

| Path relative to `dataRoot` | Size |
| --- | --- |
| `models/sensevoice-onnx/model.int8.onnx` | ~228 MB |
| `models/sensevoice-onnx/tokens.txt` | ~0.3 MB |
| `models/silero/silero_vad.onnx` | ~1.7 MB |

The official `dsh-experimental-speech-to-text-sensevoice` provider downloads them into the same `dataRoot` (`<DSH home>/speech-to-text/sensevoice`), so let that provider prepare once, or place the files at those paths yourself.

1. Build the Python environment (needs a 64-bit Python 3.11–3.13 and the Intel
   NPU driver):

   ```powershell
   pwsh -File runtime/bootstrap.ps1
   ```

2. Install the package into the profile that owns the voice-input bundle (the
   DSH desktop app uses the `desktop` profile):

   ```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:/path/to/dsh-sensevoice-npu"
   ```

   pnpm copies the package, so while iterating on it replace the copy with a
   junction to your working tree:

   ```powershell
   $d = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-sensevoice-npu"
   Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d
   New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $d -Target C:\path\to\dsh-sensevoice-npu
   ```

3. The bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml` already selects the provider and registers
   the plugin, and it contains **no machine-specific path**: `pythonPath` and
   `dataRoot` default to the `bootstrap.ps1` venv and DSH's speech root. Append an
   override to `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` (back it up first) only
   when you moved either one:

   ```yaml
   - id: speech-to-text-npu
     name: 'dsh-sensevoice-npu'
     config:
       pythonPath: <custom venv>\Scripts\python.exe   # only with -VenvDir
       dataRoot: <custom speech root>                 # only with a non-default DSH_HOME
   ```

4. Restart DSH. The voice-input card then lists
   *SenseVoiceSmall · Intel NPU (NPU)* and uses it by default; the first
   preparation compiles the NPU graph once (~2.5 min), after which starts take
   ~0.2 s. If the card still shows the CPU provider, pick the NPU one in the
   voice-input settings (an explicit choice persists over the patch default).

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pythonPath` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-sensevoice-npu\venv\Scripts\python.exe` | worker interpreter (`runtime/bootstrap.ps1` target) |
| `dataRoot` | `<DSH home>/speech-to-text/sensevoice` | DSH speech root; models are read from `<dataRoot>/models` |
| `precision` | `int8` | `int8` (`model.int8.onnx`) or `fp32` (`model.onnx`) |
| `device` | `NPU` | OpenVINO device for the recogniser (`NPU`, `GPU`, `CPU`) |
| `vadDevice` | `CPU` | Silero VAD device — tiny model, dynamic shapes, NPU rejects it |
| `useVad` | `true` | trim silence and split long speech into segments |
| `buckets` | `[64, 96, 128, 192, 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024]` (plugin config sets `[256]`) | LFR-frame buckets the engine may compile |
| `prewarmBuckets` | `[256]` | buckets compiled before the worker reports ready |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | release the worker after idling; compiled blobs stay cached |

Each bucket costs roughly 800 MB on disk (baked IR + OpenVINO NPU cache) and one
~2.5 minute compile the first time. One bucket is enough for dictation: 256
frames ≈ 15 s of audio, and the NPU handles the padding cheaply.

## Measured behaviour (Core Ultra X7 358H, Arc B390, NPU driver 32.0.100.5540)

| Case | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Warm start (compiled blob cached) | 0.21 s |
| 4.5 s Chinese clip → 256-frame bucket | `今天天气不错，我们去公园散步吧`, 0.66 s inference |
| 5.2 s clip | `明天上午10点开会，记得带上项目进度报告`, 0.48 s |
| 14.5 s clip | full sentence correct, 0.65 s |
| First compile per bucket | 100–145 s, cached afterwards |

CPU is used only for the frontend (fbank + VAD, a few ms) and JSON plumbing; the
encoder/decoder graph runs on the NPU. Note that the NPU is *not* faster than
sherpa-onnx on CPU for clips this short (~0.5 s vs ~0.2 s) — the win is moving
the heavy work off the CPU/GPU entirely.

## Development

```sh
node --test        # 6 tests, no dependencies
```

They cover the registration contract (provider id, device label, diagnostic file),
the portable `pythonPath`/`dataRoot` defaults, and the two config guards that
would otherwise fail much later: an empty bucket list and a relative path.

## Troubleshooting

* Confirm the profile really loaded the plugin and see the last phase/device:

  ```powershell
  Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\speech-to-text\sensevoice\npu\provider-status.json"
  ```

* `NPU device not visible` → update the Intel NPU driver (32.0.100.5540 tested).
* `NPU compile failed` → delete `<dataRoot>/npu` and retry; check free disk
  (~1 GB per bucket).
* Transcription slow on first use of a new bucket → it is compiling; later runs
  reuse the cache.

plugins.description: Interface zoom (Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0) for the DeepSeek Harness client — an out-of-tree Cordis client plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-ui-zoom

Interface zoom for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
client: **Ctrl+=** to zoom in, **Ctrl+-** to zoom out, **Ctrl+0** back to 100%.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![CI](https://github.com/jiangshirong/dsh-plugin-ui-zoom/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)

## Why this exists

The Harness desktop shell renders into a sandboxed renderer
(`sandbox: true`, `contextIsolation: true`, `nodeIntegration: false`), and its
preload does not expose Electron's `webFrame` zoom API. Nothing in the shipped
composition binds an interface-zoom gesture either, so the whole UI renders at a
fixed scale with no way to change it.

This plugin adds that gesture. It is a **client-half plugin**: the package root
is an inert Host row (a Loader entry needs one), and the browser half that the
module table serves does the work.

## Install

### 1. Put the package where the profile can resolve it

Run this in the profile directory (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`, for the
desktop shell that is `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jiangshirong/dsh-plugin-ui-zoom
```

`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile, so any pnpm spec
works — a git host, a tarball URL, or a local path while developing:

```sh
# while developing, from a checkout of this repository
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-ui-zoom
```

<details>
<summary>Manual equivalent</summary>

The Loader resolves a row's package from `<profile>/node_modules`, so a
directory copy works just as well:

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
mkdir -p node_modules
cp -r /path/to/dsh-plugin-ui-zoom node_modules/dsh-plugin-ui-zoom
```

</details>

### 2. Mount the row

Add this to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
# Interface zoom (Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0).
- insert:
    - id: ui-zoom
      name: dsh-plugin-ui-zoom
```

The `insert` wrapper is required. A patch row that merely names an `id` and a
`name` overrides an *existing* entry; it is silently discarded when no such
entry exists, so a new row must be inserted explicitly.

### 3. Load it

A **restart of the application** is what picks the row up, and then a **reload of
the interface** is what makes the browser half run.

Both steps are load-bearing. Mounting the row gives the Host a new Loader entry,
but the bundle URL it advertises is composed into the module graph, and adding a
client entry to an already-running application leaves that graph holding the
previous composition. A page that was already open loaded its graph at boot, so
it will not have this row either.

After the restart, the plugin appears as a Loader entry named
`<profile package name>`, and the interface reload serves its browser half from
`/plugins/<name>/client.js`.

Two failure modes are worth recognizing:

| Symptom | Cause |
|---|---|
| `1 entry did not activate` / `import failed` at startup | the bundle failed to execute — see [The module-table envelope](#the-module-table-envelope) |
| the row is active but the gestures do nothing | the interface was not reloaded after the row mounted |

The recovery dialog offers to disable third-party plugins, which rewrites the
profile patch from scratch. If you use it, the `insert` block above has to be
added again.

## Use

| Gesture | Effect |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl` + `=` | one step larger |
| `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `=` (the `+` glyph) | one step larger |
| `Ctrl` + `Numpad +` | one step larger |
| `Ctrl` + `-` | one step smaller |
| `Ctrl` + `Numpad -` | one step smaller |
| `Ctrl` + `0` / `Ctrl` + `Numpad 0` | back to 100% |

On macOS the primary modifier is `Cmd` instead of `Ctrl`.

The ladder is `50% 60% 70% 80% 90% 100% 110% 125% 150% 175% 200%`, and the
choice is remembered per browser origin. A brief percentage appears at the
bottom of the window when the scale changes.

The first three gestures are also registered as application commands
(`view.zoomIn`, `view.zoomOut`, `view.zoomReset`), so they show up in
**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts** and can be rebound there.

## How it works

```
src/index.ts     Host half — the diagnostic mirror
src/client.ts    Browser half — the plugin, the controller, and the two input paths
src/scale.ts     ladder, clamping, and preference persistence (DOM-free)
src/gestures.ts  key classification (DOM-free)
src/document.ts  the only module that writes to the document
src/trace.ts     write-only failure journal (browser side)
src/journal.ts   reading that journal back out of local storage (Node side)
scripts/build.mjs          both halves, including the module-table envelope
scripts/verify-build.mjs   executes the built bundle against the facade
scripts/install-profile.mjs copies a build into a profile with a matching id
tests/unit/                logic, controller, journal, and trace behaviour
tests/system/              the built bundle in a real engine
```

Two input paths are active at once, deliberately:

- **The shortcut registry** (`ctx.shortcuts.register`). This is the path that
  makes the gestures discoverable and rebindable, and it is how the rest of the
  product wires commands.
- **A capture-phase `keydown` listener.** The registry's code validator accepts
  only `KeyA–Z`, `Digit0–9` and function keys, so numeric-pad codes cannot be
  expressed as a binding at all; the `Ctrl+Shift+=` spelling of `+` also needs
  its own handling. The listener covers both.

Electron forwards a registry-matched binding to the page as ordinary input, so
one physical press can surface on both paths. A 60 ms guard window keeps that
press to a single step.

The scale itself is a `transform` on the application root, with inverse sizing
so the shell still covers the window:

```css
transform-origin: 0 0;
transform: scale(S);
width:  calc(100% / S);
height: calc(100% / S);
```

The transform is what keeps the rest of the UI correct. A `zoom` declaration is
the more obvious choice, but it lands inside `getBoundingClientRect()`, so a
floating layer positioned from a measured rect gets scaled a second time when
`position: fixed` resolves against the zoomed initial containing block. Measured
gap below an anchored button, where 8px is correct:

| scale | `zoom` on `:root` | `transform` on the shell |
|---|---|---|
| 100% | 8 | 8 |
| 70% | −201 | 8 |
| 110% | 77 | 8 |
| 125% | 179 | 8 |
| 150% | 348 | 8 |

A transform leaves every element's used geometry alone, so a menu anchored to a
button keeps landing on the button at every scale. `tests/system/` asserts that
gap at seven different scales; it is the regression this mechanism exists for.
The inverse sizing is the price of using a transform: a transform does not
reflow, so without it the shell would keep its unscaled layout box and leave a
gap at the right and bottom edges. Laying the shell out at `100% / S` and then
scaling it by `S` restores the bounding box, so its percentage children still
divide the real viewport.

### The module-table envelope

An out-of-tree client bundle has to reproduce an envelope that the in-repo build
pipeline normally emits. `scripts/build.mjs` writes it explicitly, because two
details of it are load-bearing and neither is obvious from reading a shipped
bundle:

1. The global is **`window.__ModuleLoader__`**. First-party bundles read
   `ow.__ModuleLoader__`, but `ow` is a local alias the bundler declares *inside
   its own output*. A plugin has no such scope, and copying the alias fails at
   boot with `Uncaught ReferenceError: ow is not defined` — which the Harness
   reports as `1 entry did not activate` and refuses to start.
2. The factory's **return value** is the module exports. The envelope may
   declare `module` and `exports`, but nothing reads `module.exports`; a factory
   that assigns to `exports` and returns nothing yields `undefined` and the row
   never mounts (`import failed`).

`npm run build` fails if either invariant is broken in the output, and
`tests/system/` executes the built artifact against the real facade in a real
engine, so the envelope cannot silently regress.

3. The envelope's `id` must equal the **row name** the bundle is mounted under.
   That name is baked in at build time, so m

plugins.description: OStan Nanami-San — a chibi desktop companion for the DeepSeek Harness GUI
plugins.readme_text:
# OStan Nanami-San 🐾

**A chibi desktop companion for the DeepSeek Harness GUI — she works when you work, waits when you're the bottleneck, and cheers when the turn lands.**

![OStan Nanami-San, four poses](docs/poses.png)

*The four packed poses: `idle` (waiting), `work` (on the job), `wait` (needs your click), `cheer` (finished).*

---

## 中文简介

OStan Nanami-San（小名「奈奈酱」）是住在 DSH 窗口右下角的小桌宠：

- **四套神态**：待机、干活中（举手示意）、等你（害羞托腮）、完成（举拳欢呼），全部来自同一角色的四张参考立绘。
- **跟着真实进度动**：某一轮对话开始 → 进入「干活中」并显示进行中的会话数；正常结束 → 欢呼台词；报错 → 担心脸；需要你确认 → **强制切换为「等你」**。
- **互动**：单击摸头（+好感度）、右键菜单投喂 / 换状态 / 调大小 / 隐藏、左键拖动换位置。
- **好感度**：摸头 +2、投喂 +6，共 6 级称号（初次见面 → 命定之人），进度条实时显示在菜单里。
- **睡觉与干活共存**：长时间没互动会打瞌睡，而**干活不会叫醒她**——你点她一下才醒，并保持清醒一段时间。唯一例外是上面的「等你」。
- **安静**：`prefers-reduced-motion` 下自动关动画；贴图与文字都随框架语言切换。

---

## What it actually is

One DSH plugin package with the standard two-face shape:

| Half | File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Host** | [`lib/index.js`](lib/index.js) | Projects live turn boundaries into one pet-state snapshot and serves `/api/ostan-nanami-san/*` plus the packaged sprites at `/ostan-nanami-san-assets/*`. |
| **Web client** | [`lib/client.js`](lib/client.js) | Mounts the companion into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` seat, polls that snapshot, renders the sprite, and owns every interaction. |

She is an **in-window** companion (the same class as the shipped whale pet), not a separate OS desktop overlay.

## Staying in step with the Host

The state is **reconciled with the Host, not merely accumulated from events**. A pure event ledger drifts in two ways this code is built to avoid:

- a session **already running when the plugin mounted** is never announced, so the pet sits idle while the user's session works — the tracker adopts the live agent registry (`ctx.agents.list()`) at mount, on every config reload, and (throttled to 1 s) on every state poll, so a gap heals within one poll instead of needing a restart;
- one **missed `turn/end`** pins a session at "running" forever — reconcile drops any agent the Host no longer lists.

Three more rules keep the face honest:

- **She follows the session you are looking at.** This client face has no `sessions.list` to read the current session from, and scraping the DOM for a session marker would be fragile and forbidden — so the bundle seats a **zero-pixel probe in `conversation.chat.turnTail`**, a session-scoped slot whose standard props carry `sessionId`. The probe hands that id to the floating companion, which rides it on every poll (`/state?current=<id>`), and the Host narrows every read to that one session.
- **The menu reports the scope the Host actually used, not the one the client asked for.** The Host answers with `following`:
  - `session` — the reported id is one it has recorded, so the readings are that session's;
  - `unknown` — an id was sent that the Host has never seen (a session with no recorded turn yet). The readings in force are the Host-wide ones, and the menu says so rather than claiming a scope the numbers did not come from;
  - `host` — no session was reported at all.

  `/state?ids=1` additionally returns the tracked session ids. It exists for one caller — a human debugging scope with `curl` — and carries session identity only, never a title or message text; the ordinary poll omits it.
- **Subagents never count as the user's work.** Their turns appear in the snapshot as `subagents` for diagnosis but do not drive the pet: the user did not start them and does not watch them, so counting them makes the pet look busy while the visible session sits idle.
- **A live question outranks a running turn.** A turn blocked on the user has nothing to show, so she says "waiting for you" rather than looking busy — the *waiting* face plus a `正在等你回答…` pill. The signal is durable log truth, not a live event: `ask_user_question` **blocks the turn** inside `ctx.userQuestions` until an answer lands, so its open `tool/call` *is* the pending question and its matching `tool/result` *is* the answer. `turn/end` clears it whatever the reason, so an abort cannot leave her waiting forever.

  > This was once broken, which is worth recording: an earlier version listened for a `question/request` **session event that does not exist** in `SessionEventMap`. The handler was unreachable, so the waiting face never appeared. `tests/host.test.mjs` now asserts that an invented event type moves nothing.

## Features

- **Live state machine.** `work` while a turn runs (with a badge counting busy sessions), `wait` while a structured question is unanswered, `cheer` for six seconds after a turn completes normally, a worried face for twenty seconds after a failure, `idle` otherwise. Priority is deliberate: waiting outranks work (a blocked turn has nothing to show), then a fresh failure, then a fresh success. A user *cancellation* is neither a success nor a failure, so she never celebrates a Ctrl-C.
- **A step readout.** A quiet pill above her reports what the work is *doing* — "正在读文件…", "正在跑命令…", "正在搜代码…" — and keeps the last step for one beat after the turn lands ("上一步：正在改代码"). It names the **kind** of step and nothing else; see the boundary note below.
- **Four poses, one character.** The artwork is cut out of the four supplied reference illustrations, so a state change is a genuine change of expression rather than a tint or a wobble.
- **Affinity.** Pats (+2, 800 ms cooldown) and snacks (+6, 1.5 s cooldown) accumulate into six titled levels; the level-up announces itself in a speech bubble.
- **Drag anywhere, drop anywhere.** Position persists per browser; the pet is clamped into the viewport on resize.
- **Right-click menu.** Live-status follow vs. a manual mood override, size (84–320 px), motion pause, reset position, hide — and a 🐾 button to call her back.
- **Two languages.** The dictionary follows the frame language (`<html lang>`); switching language re-reads it live.
- **Quiet by construction.** Idle chatter is rate-limited and stays silent while the Host is busy, and reduced-motion disables the sprite animation.

## Install

The package ships prebuilt: no build step, no install scripts, no network access at runtime.

```sh
# through the Harness plugin manager (it owns the profile's package.json,
# its bundle list, and the pnpm run)
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <absolute path to this directory>

# or straight from GitHub once published
dsh plugin install github:Hrauroras/dsh-plugin-ostan-nanami-san
```

On this Windows desktop install it landed in the **`desktop`** profile (the one the app actually boots — `$env:DSH_PROFILE` is the authority, not a guess):

```json
"dependencies": { "dsh-plugin-ostan-nanami-san": "link:C:/Users/A2178/Downloads/dsh-plugin-ostan-nanami-san" },
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-plugin-ostan-nanami-san"] } }
```

The `link:` spec installs a junction, so a source edit here reaches the running Host on the next page load; only the Host half needs a DSH restart to re-import.

Confirm it is live:

```sh
curl 'http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/ostan-nanami-san/health'
# {"ok":true,"version":"0.6.0","sessions":1}
```

> Already running a whale companion? Both can live in the same frame; she seats herself at `order: 88`, the whale pet at `order: 90`.

## Usage

| Gesture | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Click | Pat her head (affinity +2) |
| Drag | Move her; the spot sticks |
| Right-click | Menu: pat, snack, mood override, size, motion, reset, hide |
| Click the badge area | — (the badge counts sessions currently working) |

## Privacy and runtime boundaries

- Reads **turn, question and tool boundaries only** — session id, event sequence, and a tool's *name*. No message text, no tool arguments, no file contents, no history, no model calls.
- No telemetry, no external requests, no additional listening port, no model calls, no approval handling.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-meter

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web / 桌面端用的**花费计**插件：在输入框正下方常驻一枚小胶囊，直接告诉你**这次回答花了多少钱**、**这个会话一共花了多少钱**。

```
本会话消耗 ¥1.23 · 本次回答 ¥0.087            空闲价 · 2h15m 后转高峰
```

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

## 它显示什么

- **本次回答** —— 最近一次已完成轮次（turn）的估算费用。轮次结束的那一刻刷新并闪一下提示。
- **本会话消耗** —— 当前会话的累计估算费用，含正在进行中的那一轮。
- 点击胶囊展开**逐轮明细**：每轮金额、token 四桶拆分（缓存命中读 / 未命中读 / 缓存写 / 输出）、当轮生效单价、高峰/空闲标记、轮内步数；账本里有多个会话时再列出本机已记账的全部会话与总计。

## 安装

用 DSH 的 Plugin Manager 安装本 bundle：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本目录绝对路径或本仓库>
```

或直接指向本仓库：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: github:Lopncod/dsh-cost-meter
```

安装后 **需要重启 DSH**：宿主半是启动时 `import` 的 ESM 模块，运行中改文件或重新启用 bundle 都不会重新加载（这一点本地实测确认过）。

## 计价口径

按 DeepSeek 官方价目（人民币 / 百万 token）与**峰谷计价**规则估算：

| 计费桶 | 含义 | Flash 空闲 / 高峰 | Pro 空闲 / 高峰 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 缓存命中读 | 复用前缀缓存的输入 | 0.02 / 0.04 | 0.15 / 0.30 |
| 未命中读 | 未命中缓存的输入 | 1 / 2 | 4.5 / 9 |
| 缓存写 | 写入缓存的输入（按未命中价计） | 1 / 2 | 4.5 / 9 |
| 输出 | 补全（含推理 token） | 4 / 8 | 13.5 / 27 |

- **高峰时段** = 北京时间**周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00**；其余时段（含周末与中国法定节假日全天）按空闲价。
- 金额是**估算值**，不是账单金额；真实扣费以 DeepSeek 侧余额变化为准。

### token 口径（关键实现细节）

四个桶来自会话日志里 `assistant/message` 事件携带的**真实 `usage`**（模型实际被计费的那份数），**不做 token 估算**：

- `inputTokens` 是**未缓存**桶，与 `cacheReadTokens`、`cacheWriteTokens` **互斥**，三者相加才是 prompt 总量。这一点抄的是 DSH 自己的权威定义 —— `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` 的 `tokenUsage` projection 把它命名为 `uncachedInputTokens` 并与另两个桶相加（见 `lib/types/usage-projection.js`）。
- `reasoningTokens` 是 `outputTokens` 的子集，**不再单独计费**，否则输出侧会被翻倍计费。
- 同一 `(turn, step)` 的重复结算**替换**而非累加；`llm/retry-started` 才重开替换槽 —— 与 token-meter 的 `addReplacing` 同语义，避免重试/重复订阅把一轮算两遍。

## 配置（可选）

`$DSH_HOME/.dsh-cost.json`（Windows 默认 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\.dsh-cost.json`），保存后自动生效，无需重启：

```json
{
  "peakMode": "auto",
  "defaultModel": "deepseek-flash",
  "rates": {
    "my-proxy-flash": { "hit": 0.01, "miss": 0.5, "out": 2 }
  }
}
```

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `peakMode` | `"auto"`（默认，按北京时间判峰谷）/ `"always"`（全按高峰价，上限估算）/ `"never"`（全按空闲价） |
| `defaultModel` | `request/header` 缺失时（老日志、非标准调用）用来选价目表的模型名 |
| `rates` | 自定义单价，键是**模型 id 的子串**（最长匹配优先，覆盖内置行），值 `{hit, miss, out}` 为**元/百万 token**；写单个数字表示峰谷同价；键 `_default` 改兜底价 |

账本落在 `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-cost-ledger.json`（逐会话逐轮记录）。删掉它只影响历史显示，下次事件会重新累积。

## 接口

宿主半通过 `ctx.webServer` 提供几个只读路由，同源脚本也能读：

| 路由 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-cost/state?sessionId=<id>` | 当前会话 + 全部会话汇总 + 峰谷状态；`sessionId` 不在账本时会回退到最近有记录的会话，并带 `fallback: true` |
| `GET /dsh-cost/rates` | 生效的内置 / 自定义价目表 |
| `GET /dsh-cost/debug` | 最近 12 次 `/state` 请求的完整 URL —— 排查"页面到底有没有在问、问的是哪个 id" |

DSH 的浏览器鉴权栅栏只套在 `/api` 通道上，插件路由不受其影响。

## 开发

```bash
npm test        # 18 项：峰谷边界、价目表最长匹配、真实缓存请求定价、替换语义、账本 JSON 往返
```

目录：

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/pricing.js` | 纯函数计价层：峰谷判定、价目表解析、四桶拆分、费用计算 |
| `lib/ledger.js` | 会话事件折叠成逐轮 / 逐会话账本，含 `(turn, step)` 替换语义与持久化结构 |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半：监听 `session/event`、落账本、提供 HTTP 路由 |
| `client.js` | 客户端半：`conversation.composer.dock` 槽位的胶囊与明细弹层 |

技术要点：客户端半是 DSH 的**动态客户端模块**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`），只从冻结平台表 `require('react')`，不 require 任何 Harness 客户端包；样式全部内联且只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token。

## 已知限制

- **只统计插件启用之后的轮次。** 账本由 `session/event` 实时累积；启用前跑过的旧会话没有历史记录。
- 子代理会话按各自 `sessionId` 单独记账，不计入父会话那一行；总计会一起算。
- fork / resume 出来的会话只累计**本进程内新发生**的事件，被复制的历史前缀不重复计费（与实际计费一致）。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © Lopncod

plugins.description: Delete a session from the DSH sidebar. A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-eraser

Delete a session from the DSH sidebar, permanently removing its stored log and
its workspace accounting.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-eraser
```

Then **restart DSH**. The command installs the package, applies this package's
`cordis.patch.yml` through the `dsh.bundle.patch` mechanism, and adds the package
to the profile's bundle list — no manual configuration editing.

Without the `dsh` CLI, add the package to the profile's `node_modules` and put
this in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-session-eraser
      name: dsh-session-eraser
```

## What it does

Adds a **Delete session** entry to each session row in the sidebar, in two
places:

- the row's `...` menu, below the shipped **Archive** row;
- a hover-revealed trash button beside the row's other actions.

Either entry opens a confirmation dialog. Confirming removes the session's
stored artifact from disk, detaches it from the Workspace, and tells every
connected client that the session is gone, so the row disappears immediately.

## The open-session guard

Deleting the session that is **currently open in the main panel is refused.**

This is deliberate. The Workspace UI reconciles an *archived* current selection
but has no path that reacts to the current session being *removed*: it exposes no
public close/leave API, and `openSession` can only replace. Deleting the open
session would therefore leave the main panel pointing at a session that no longer
exists, with the composer silently disabled and no way back.

So the guard refuses in four places:

| Entry point | Behaviour when the session is open |
| --- | --- |
| `...` menu row | Rendered disabled, labelled *Delete session (currently open)* |
| Hover trash button | Not rendered at all |
| Dialog confirm button | Disabled, with an inline explanation |
| Dialog confirm action | Re-checks retention and refuses |

The hover button is omitted rather than disabled because a natively disabled
button fires no pointer events, so its tooltip could never explain the refusal —
and the row-action slot's own catalog prescribes rendering nothing when an action
does not apply to the row.

## Host route

`POST /api/session.delete`

```jsonc
// request
{ "sessionId": "session-04e8f277-…" }

// 200
{ "ok": true, "status": "deleted", "live": true, "detached": true, "removed": 1 }
```

| Status | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | `{ ok: true, … }` | Deleted, and verified gone from disk |
| 400 | `{ error: "…" }` | Malformed body, or missing/invalid `sessionId` |
| 404 | `{ error: "session not found" }` | No stored artifact and no live session |
| 500 | `{ error: "…" }` | Unexpected failure, **or the artifact survived removal** |

The route never reports success it cannot verify. `rm` fails for real reasons on
Windows — a locked or deny-ACL'd file throws `EPERM`/`EBUSY` — so after removing
the artifact the plugin re-checks the path and answers **500** if anything
survived, leaving the workspace accounting untouched so the sidebar keeps showing
the session that in fact still exists.

The route is served through the connection's Fetch handler, so it sits behind the
same authentication gate as the rest of `/api` and is reachable only from a
trusted origin.

## Deletion sequence

The Host has no session-eraser API, so deletion is composed from public pieces in
a specific order:

1. `workspaces.stopSessionActivity(sessionId)` — request a stop for the session.
2. `sessions.liveEntryFor(live)` + `sessions.detachEntered(entry)` — detach the
   live session, which also dispatches `session/disposed`.
3. Settle the writer. Persistence teardown's `writer.close()` is **not awaited**,
   and `appendLines` opens the log with `open(path, "a")` per batch — which
   **recreates a deleted directory** — so a drain that loses the race would
   resurrect the log. Two mechanisms cover this:
   - `settleWriter(...)` joins the in-flight close directly. It reads an
     undocumented internal (`persistence.tracker.openHandles`) and **fails open**
     if that is ever renamed, so it is an optimization, not the guarantee.
   - `persistence.flush()` — the **public** durability barrier — drains every
     active write handle, and a concurrently-closing handle counts as flushed.
   - When neither could be awaited, the removal is held for a bounded settle
     window, re-removing anything a late drain restores.
4. Remove each located artifact, then **verify** it is gone. Anything that
   survived is reported as a failure rather than a success.
5. Re-index the workspace, **clear the session's archive and pin entries**, and
   detach it from its owning entities.
6. `ctx.emit("api-session/removed", sessionId)` — so cold sessions vanish from
   other clients immediately, not just on the next list refresh.

Step 5's archive/pin cleanup matters because those are registry-global id lists:
deleting the session removes the row they refer to, so nothing in the UI can ever
offer to unarchive or unpin it — the id would dangle permanently. Both removal
APIs skip the session-existence check by design ("an entry whose session is gone
still resolves"), which is exactly this case.

Owners are captured *before* re-indexing, because `entity.sessionIds` is filtered
live by the canonical-cwd header index and re-indexing prunes the id.

## Storage layout

Artifacts live under `~/.dsh/sessions/<encoded-project-dir>/<encoded-id>/`, with
the log at `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`. The plugin mirrors the backend's
`encodeSegment` exactly, so a hostile `sessionId` (traversal sequences, absolute
paths, separators) can only ever resolve to its own escaped directory inside the
root. `test/host-traversal.test.mjs` plants canaries and proves this.

## Tests

```sh
node test/run.mjs
```

The `host-*` suites are hermetic — they use throwaway persistence roots and stub
the services the route touches. The `live-*` suites talk to a running app
(`DSH_TEST_ORIGIN`, default `http://127.0.0.1:19387`) and self-skip when it is
unreachable.

| Suite | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `host-route.test.mjs` | Cold-session deletion, status codes, artifact removal |
| `host-live.test.mjs` | Live-session branch: stop, detach, settle, owner detach |
| `host-writer-race.test.mjs` | A late writer drain must not resurrect the log |
| `host-race-control.test.mjs` | The same race *without* the fix must fail — proves the fix is load-bearing |
| `host-internals-change.test.mjs` | Deletion stays correct when `tracker.openHandles` is absent |
| `host-bookkeeping.test.mjs` | A deleted session leaves no dangling archive/pin entry |
| `host-partial-failure.test.mjs` | A real `EPERM` from a deny-ACL is reported, not swallowed |
| `host-traversal.test.mjs` | Hostile ids resolve only to escaped in-root directories |
| `client-guard.test.mjs` | Both entry points and the dialog, including the open-session guard |
| `live-end-to-end.test.mjs` | Authenticated HTTP against the running app, including a real deletion |
| `live-bundle.test.mjs` | The running app serves the guarded client bundle at the advertised revision |

`live-*` mints its own auth cookie from the browser-session signing secret in
`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`; no browser or cookie jar is involved.

## Known limitations

- **Attachments are not removed.** Deletion removes the session log and its
  workspace accounting; files the session referenced on disk are left in place
  (their references go away with the log). Removing them would require knowing
  which files the session actually created rather than merely read.
- **The open-session guard is client-side only.** The Host has no view-state
  concept — `mainView` retention lives in the browser — so a hand-crafted
  `POST /api/session.delete` for the currently-open session is not refused. The
  route is behind the normal auth gate, so this is reachable only by the user's
  own authenticated client, and the shipped UI never sends it.
- **`settleWriter` reads an internal.** `persistence.tracker.openHandles` is not
  part of the documented seam. The plugin treats it as an optimization: if it
  disappears, the public `flush()` barrier and the bounded settle wi

plugins.description: To play with DeepSeek's Completion API and check logprobs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-completion-playground

A fullscreen raw-prompt playground for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness),
packaged as an **agent mode**. Every "Run" is an ordinary conversation turn whose model
call happens to be DeepSeek's raw
[`/beta/completions`](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-completion/) endpoint — so the
harness keeps doing the work it already knows: Chat, the built-in Trajectory, the session
list, token accounting and cancellation.

## What you get

- **New Session** — the mode picker offers **Playground Mode**. The hero screen stays
  exactly as shipped (mode chip, workspace picker, normal composer).
- **After the first turn** — a **Completion** tab appears with a fullscreen prompt editor.
  The shipped *Chat* and *Trajectory* tabs are untouched, and the native composer is vacated,
  so no second input box floats under the transcript.
- **Logprob** — a sibling tab that runs the prompt as an ordinary turn while asking the endpoint
  for `logprobs`, then draws every position's candidate distribution as probability bars. It has
  its own `max_tokens` and candidate count (1–20). The run is a real turn, so it appears in
  Trajectory; the distribution rides the assistant message, so the bars come back after a tab
  switch or a reload.
- **Run** — the whole document is sent as one user message, the completion streams back and is
  appended to the document. `Stop` cancels the turn (and the upstream request).
- **max_tokens** (1–4096; the endpoint documents a 4K cap) and a **stop list** with escape
  sequences, sent as the request's `max_tokens` / `stop`.
- **Trajectory** — each Run is a real turn: one user record (the document at that moment) plus
  one assistant record (what the model wrote).

## Install

From GitHub (pin a tag for reproducibility):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:Zhichii/dsh-completion-playground#v0.3.0
```

Or open **Settings → Plugins → Install**, paste the same spec, and confirm. A git install
tracks the default branch unless you pin `#<ref>`.

The package ships plain ESM (`index.js`) and a plain browser bundle (`client.js`) — there is no
build step and no install script, so the install needs no build approval.

### Configure the API key

The Host half resolves the reference `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` through the harness credential seam
(`ctx.credentials`) and falls back to the process environment. The value is sent only to the
configured upstream. Optional environment overrides:

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DSH_COMPLETION_BETA_BASE_URL` | Upstream base URL, default `https://api.deepseek.com/beta` |
| `DSH_COMPLETION_ATTRIBUTION` | `User-Agent` sent upstream (white-labelling) |

## Use

1. New Session → pick **Playground Mode**.
2. Write the first prompt in the normal composer. The mode has already claimed the session, so
   that first request is already pinned to the completion route.
3. Click the **Completion** tab → the fullscreen editor. Write the document, then **Run**
   (or `Ctrl/Cmd + Enter`).
4. Inspect the **Trajectory** tab: the Run is recorded as a turn.

### Stop sequences

The stop field is single-line, so line breaks are typed as escapes (decoded in the browser,
sent upstream as real characters):

| Typed | Sent as the stop sequence |
|---|---|
| `\n` | one line feed |
| `\n\n` | two consecutive line feeds (stop at a blank line) |
| `\nUser:` | line feed followed by `User:` |
| `\t` | one tab |
| `\\` | one literal backslash |

Unknown escapes (`\q`) keep their backslash. At most 16 sequences; empty rows are dropped.

## Gemini mode

The bundle also ships a second mode, **Gemini 模式** — a chat wrapper over the same endpoint that
speaks a Gemini-style transcript instead of raw documents:

```
User
<your message>

Gemini
**Analyzing
```

- **No system prompt.** The adapter never reads system or developer messages, and the mode's preset
  declares no prompt sections, so nothing the deployment would normally inject reaches the model.
  Persona and style live in the few-shot rounds instead.
- **No tool calls.** The preset composes no tools and the adapter ignores tool declarations and tool
  results; the request carries no `tools` field.
- **Few-shot prefix**: `gemini-prefix.md` ships beside the module — a real Gemini-style transcript
  (four rounds, `<think>` blocks and all) that leads every request. It carries both the format and
  the persona, because this mode sends no system prompt.
- **Postfix**: the prompt closes with `Gemini\n<think>\n**Analyzing` (the heading is left open), so the
  model completes it, writes the analysis, closes `</think>` and then answers. Setting
  `geminiPostfix: "Gemini\n"` instead makes the model emit `<think>` itself, so the stored answer
  begins with the tag.
- Both are overridable through the bundle row's config:

  ```yaml
  - id: completion-plan-b-host
    name: 'dsh-completion-playground'
    config:
      geminiPrefix: |          # replaces the shipped transcript entirely
        User
        你是谁

        Gemini
        …
      geminiPostfix: "Gemini\n<think>\n**Analyzing"   # or "Gemini\n" to let the model write <think>
      geminiStops: ['\nUser\n']    # default: keep the model from speaking as the user
      geminiEcho: true               # echo the primed opener into the answer (default)
      geminiMaxTokens: 2048          # default output cap
  ```

- The shipped prefix is a stable ~4K-token prefix, so the provider's prompt cache should absorb most
  of its cost from the second request on.
- **Echo**: the primed opener is re-emitted by the adapter as the answer's first text delta, so the
  saved assistant message *starts with* `<think>\n**Analyzing…` even though that text was primed into
  the prompt. The echo is derived from the postfix (the `Gemini\n` role tag is stripped), so it follows
  whatever opener you configure; `geminiEcho: false` turns it off and leaves the prefill out of the
  stored message.
- **Routing** is decided on the Host from the session's own preset: a `completion-gemini` provider
  route is pinned per request, so the mode needs no browser half and uses the shipped Chat UI
  (no extra tab, no custom editor).
- The composer's model selector may still show the deployment default: the pin is applied per
  request rather than written into the session's model selection, because that write would persist
  the route as the whole deployment's default model.

Preset id `completion-gemini` (recorded per session, therefore stable); display name `Gemini 模式`.

## How it works

```
Run ──▶ ctx.remote.session.prompt(document)
     ──▶ Agent loop assembles a real turn
     ──▶ provider route `completion-beta` (host half): prompt = the last human user message
     ──▶ POST {baseURL}/completions   stream: true
     ──▶ assistant text streams back; the editor appends it to the document
```

- **Host half** (`index.js`): `ctx.llm.registerAdapter(['completion-beta'], adapter)`; a
  `/completion-plan-b/max-tokens` route receives each session's `max_tokens` + `stop` + `logprobs`;
  an `agent/request` waterfall listener (prepended) pins the route and the request controls for
  claimed sessions, so the deployment's default model is never rewritten.
- **Browser half** (`client.js`): a watcher in `conversation.input.dock` notices the session's
  `agentPreset` projection, claims it, and — once the session has history — registers this
  mode's two `conversation.view` entries plus a `conversation.composer` chain takeover that
  vacates the native composer.
- **How the Logprob tab gets its distribution**: `logprobs` is not a field of `LlmCallConfig`, so
  it travels on the same claim channel as `max_tokens` and the adapter reads it back through the
  request's own `sessionId`. The per-position distribution leaves on the `finish` chunk's
  `replayState` (`{response}`, with `blocks` omitted), which the harness stores on the assistant
  message's `source`. The run is therefore an ordinary turn — in Trajectory, cancellable, metered
  — and the browser half only reads the log back. At most 512 positions are stored; beyond that
  only the count is kept.
- **Why a provider route instead of a private HTTP call**:
